Rina (People Ops): Heads-up: rolling out three related policy tweaks today: 1) expanded sabbatical eligibility (3-year tenure -> 2 years for individual contributors); 2) phased-return guidance after parental leave (up to 8 weeks partial schedule option); 3) travel-tax advisory for long business trips that may affect tax residency. Full doc & request forms: https://intranet.redwood/people/sabbatical-phased-return-tax-2026 — please read if any applies to you. :notes:

Omar (Finance): Quick on the tax advisory  if you're traveling for >183 days in a foreign country for business, local tax rules can apply. TaxAssistBot will send a pre-travel checklist for stays >30 days and Finance will flag trips that may hit residency thresholds. If in doubt, open a ticket so we can review with Legal.

TaxAssistBot: Tax check launched. Commands: `/tax check <trip-id>` `/tax help`. Upload travel itinerary to get auto-review. See https://intranet.redwood/taxassist for details.

Sana (Legal): Clarify: the company can't provide tax advice, but we will coordinate with external counsel for high-risk cases and advise on payroll implications. For long assignments we'll provide a coordination checklist (visa, payroll, local counsel).

Diego (Eng): Sabbatical expansion — does this mean people with 2 years can apply immediately? Any limits?

Rina (People Ops): Yes  effective today employees with 2+ years tenure can apply. Sabbatical length & pay tiers unchanged (4 weeks unpaid sabbatical standard; partial paid options for senior ICs per policy). Managers will get an approval workflow in the HR modal. Applications are reviewed quarterly.

Priya (Benefits): Note: while on sabbatical, benefit coverage continues for eligible employees if duration <=12 weeks; for longer leaves we'll coordinate COBRA/benefits continuation per region. See the benefits section in the policy doc.

Marta (Manager): For phased-return after parental leave, can we adjust hours from 80% to 100% over the 8 weeks? How formal is the plan?

Rina (People Ops): Good Q  phased-return is flexible: typical pattern is 6-8 weeks with a weekly schedule agreed between employee and manager (e.g., 60% -> 80% -> 100%). We ask for a short plan in the return-to-work form so People Ops can track adjustments and make accommodations for benefits/oncall. No medical documentation required unless requested by local law.

Diego (Eng): If someone takes a sabbatical and also was on parental leave earlier in the year, any sequencing rules? 

Priya (Benefits): You'll need to ensure leave entitlements don't overlap in ways that affect benefits. People Ops will work with Payroll/Benefits case-by-case. If both leaves are part of the same accommodation plan, tell us in the application so we can coordinate payroll.

Omar (Finance): Operational note on payroll: sabbatical unpaid days will show as unpaid leave unless you opt into partial paid tiers. For long cross-border travel, payroll may need to process taxes differently; allow extra time for payroll processing (we recommend starting coordination 30 days before travel).

Sana (Legal): For managers approving phased-returns or sabbaticals involving cross-border work, please loop Legal if travel >30 days or customer site assignments across borders. We added a short checklist in the doc.

TaxAssistBot: Reminder: users with planned trips >30 days will receive an automated DM with the residency checklist. Use `/tax check` early to avoid surprises.

Marta (Manager): Any grandfathering for people who applied under the old 3-year rule but were denied? Can they reapply?

Rina (People Ops): We will automatically requeue previously denied sabbatical applications from employees with 2+ years — People Ops will email affected employees with next steps. If you were denied for operational reasons, managers can resubmit with updated coverage plans.

Diego (Eng): Thanks  sharing with my team. One more: will sabbatical approvals be limited during major launch weeks?

Rina (People Ops): We do reserve the right to stagger leaves during critical windows. The policy includes a launch-sensitive scheduling note: managers may request a brief delay (usually ~2 weeks) for operational coverage; exceptions for emergencies will be considered.

Priya (Benefits): Office hours tomorrow 11am PT to walk through sabbatical forms, phased-return templates, and the tax checklist. We'll pin the doc in People Ops after the session. :pushpin:

Omar (Finance): If you have specific long-trip questions, open a ticket with Finance and attach your itinerary so TaxAssistBot can triage faster.

Rina (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you think this impacts you, please read the doc and either apply via HR modal or drop into office hours. We want these options to be usable, not just policy text. :seedling:
